messages:
Samir Khatri: PSA — pausing the model canary rollout for v3.10 quantized builds. Observed a quality regression in reranks on a small prompt set and an unexpected p95 latency increase on long-context requests. Effective immediately until we diagnose.

Jen Park: Acknowledged. Which checks failed exactly? Need a short blurb for product and customer-ops.

Alex Mora: From infra: latency on long-context 8k requests p95 rose from 240ms -> 370ms in canary cluster. Model scoring drift: rerank precision_fall ~3.2% on canary eval harness vs baseline. I've paused subsequent batch jobs and pinned traffic back to stable.

Anita Chen: From ML: small quantization change to dequant reorder appears to alter softmax tails. Re-running calibration with the older kernel to compare. Will post eval diffs in the runbook.

deploy-bot: Notice: canary rollouts for v3.10-quant are paused. PRs labeled `deploy:quant-rollout` will not advance. Use `deploy:quant-urgent` for security/hotpatch exceptions.

Lina Gomez: I'll draft a short customer-facing note with expected ETA for investigation (aiming 6-12h) and add a banner to internal status.

Maya Rivera (oncall): Oncall action: mirroring alerts for p50/p95 and evaluation regression thresholds. If quality delta > 2% or p95 > baseline +120ms for 5m, page release and ML leads. I'll watch now.

Samir Khatri: Rollback/abort criteria added to runbook: auto-revert to stable if quality delta > 2% on the canary eval set OR p95 increase > 120ms sustained 5m. Manual continue only after cross-team signoff.

Anita Chen: ML will produce a short patch candidate (restore old kernel path) within 3h. If that mitigates drift we'll re-run a trimmed canary with 5% traffic.

Alex Mora: Infra will reserve an extra g4 pool for the trimmed canary and prepare a fail-open route to the stable model.

Samir Khatri: Proposed lift: only after ML + infra signoff and a 4h stable window on the trimmed canary. Please ack here. :thumbsup:

Jen Park: +1 — I'll notify PMs and schedule a 30m sync in 2h.

Lina Gomez: +1 from partner comms.

Anita Chen: +1, starting calibration run now.

deploy-bot: Automated reminder: posting update to this thread every 2h until resolved.
